text: The prohibition of on-street overnight parking south of Finch Avenue East was considered and approved by Scarborough Community Council on September 16, 2019. Subsequently, the previous Councillor received numerous emails from residents expressing their concerns that there was insufficient off-street parking available. COVID-19 only served to exacerbate the problem as family members consolidated their living arrangements to look after one another and unemployed family members returned home due to financial pressures. Therefore, I am asking the members of Scarborough Community Council to support the revocation of the prohibition of overnight on-street parking south of Finch Avenue East, east of Victoria Park, west of Midland Avenue and north of Highway 401.
Scarborough Community Council withdrew the Item.
